Package org.geysermc.paletter.creative

Record Class CreativeGroup

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
org.geysermc.paletter.creative.CreativeGroup
Record Components:
name - the group name, usually a translation key like itemGroup.name.minecart. Unique across the layout, except that CreativeOrdering.BDS creates a group of the same name in another category when content asks for a group its category lacks, as BDS does; lookups by name find the first
icon - the stack shown on the collapsed group, or null to use the first stack that exists in the client's version
stacks - the stacks in the group, in order
All Implemented Interfaces:
CreativeNode
public record CreativeGroup(@NonNull String name, @Nullable BedrockItemStack icon, @NonNull List<BedrockItemStack> stacks) extends Record implements CreativeNode
A named, collapsible group in a creative category. Immutable; edit through CreativeEditor.

1.0.0
